Your baby’s safety

Always our top priority

Every newborn session is carefully designed with comfort, patience, and safety in mind. Composite poses are created to ensure babies are always fully supported, and every session follows a baby-centric approach in a calm and temperature-controlled studio environment.

Frequently asked questions

Everything you’d like to know

We recommend scheduling between 28–32 weeks, when your bump is beautifully rounded and you still feel comfortable. Booking early is highly recommended, as our most requested dates fill quickly.

Newborn sessions are ideally photographed within the first 7–14 days after birth, while babies are still naturally sleepy and curled for those timeless portraits.

Yes. You will have access to our luxury client closet with over 150 designer-inspired maternity gowns and styling pieces for maternity and motherhood sessions.

Absolutely. We encourage partners and siblings to participate in your maternity and newborn session to create timeless family portraits and meaningful memories together.

Yes. Flexible payment options are available through Afterpay, Klarna, Affirm, and PayPal Credit, to make your luxury portrait experience more accessible and stress-free.

Your baby’s safety is always our highest priority. Every session is carefully guided using gentle, baby-led posing techniques, and composite poses ensure your little one is safe, comfortable, and fully supported throughout.

We proudly serve Houston, Cypress, Katy, Spring, Tomball, Sugar Land, The Woodlands, Memorial, and surrounding Texas areas.

Luxury maternity, newborn, and baby portraiture with an editorial approach: timeless imagery, personalized styling, guided posing, professional retouching, and a full-service experience designed to make every mother feel confident, beautiful, and celebrated.
